SELECT c.club_number as clubNumber, c.status, f.festival_number as festivalNumber , f.festival_name as festivalName, c.club_name as clubName, c.purpose, a.account_number as accountNumber, a.nickname, c.created_at as createdAt FROM clubs c JOIN festivals f ON f.FESTIVAL_NUMBER = c.FESTIVAL_NUMBER JOIN attendees atd ON atd.CLUB_NUMBER = c.CLUB_NUMBER AND atd.attendee_role = 0 JOIN accounts a ON a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = atd.ACCOUNT_NUMBER
AND c.status = #{status}
AND c.purpose = #{purpose}
AND c.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{clubName}, '%')
AND f.festival_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{festivalName}, '%')
AND a.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.club_number DESC
ORDER BY c.club_number DESC

SELECT c.club_number as clubNumber, c.status, f.festival_number as festivalNumber , f.festival_name as festivalName, c.club_name as clubName, c.purpose, a.account_number as accountNumber, a.nickname, c.created_at as createdAt FROM clubs c JOIN festivals f ON f.FESTIVAL_NUMBER = c.FESTIVAL_NUMBER JOIN attendees atd ON atd.CLUB_NUMBER = c.CLUB_NUMBER AND atd.attendee_role = 0 JOIN accounts a ON a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = atd.ACCOUNT_NUMBER WHERE c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.CLUB_NUMBER DESC;
